questions.question: Star Trek's Captain Picard, Patrick Stewart, took Dickens's A Christmas Carol to Broadway in 1991. The story has more than 40 characters, yet the cast list had just one name. How?
alternative_answers: He did all the voices and roles alone
One actor played all the parts
questions.source_excerpt: A Christmas Carol, opened Dec 19, 1991, closed Dec 29, 1991; Drama Desk Award for Outstanding Solo Performance/One Person Show

topicality.rationale: 1991 Broadway trivia with no current news hook in the question.

extra.verification_notes: Stewart performed Dickens's A Christmas Carol as a solo show on Broadway in Dec 1991 (IBDB, Drama Desk solo performance award); no newer event contradicts this, though the '40+ characters' count was not verified.

local_scope.reason: Patrick Stewart's Broadway one-man Christmas Carol; international pop culture

questions.explanation: Patrick Stewart turned A Christmas Carol into a one-man show. Alone on an almost bare stage, he played Scrooge, Bob Cratchit, Tiny Tim, Marley and all three ghosts, switching between them with just his voice and body. He first developed it in Britain in the late 1980s, then took it to Broadway in 1991 and revived it several times.
